The correct response is not to appeal, not to find a workaround, and not to use a friend's account in another country. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain and fires a webhook the moment a transaction confirms. Your backend processes the order and delivers the product automatically. No platform involved at any step.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital paypal

When it comes to selling digital products, each of these platforms has its own set of features and limitations. Stripe, for instance, is a payment gateway that's widely accepted but only operates in 46 countries out of 195 on earth. PayPal, on the other hand, is a more popular choice but has a history of account suspensions, which can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. Gumroad is a platform specifically designed for selling digital products, but it's not available in many countries, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. Lemon Squeezy is another alternative, but it's also not available in several countries, leaving creators with limited options.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The reality is that many creators are forced to navigate these platform restrictions, often relying on workarounds or expensive alternatives to reach their customers. However, there's a better way to sell digital art without relying on these platforms. By building a sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can gain full control over their online store, payment processing, and customer relationships, free from the limitations imposed by these gatekeepers.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

One of the biggest advantages of a sovereign commerce infrastructure is the ability to process payments quickly and efficiently, without relying on third-party gatekeepers. With NOWPayments, creators can receive payments in 300+ cryptocurrencies, with fees as low as 0.5%. This not only saves time but also reduces costs associated with payment processing, allowing creators to keep more of their earnings.
Building a sovereign commerce infrastructure gives creators full control over their online store, payment processing, and customer relationships.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Another key benefit of a sovereign commerce infrastructure is the ability to own and control every aspect of the sales process, from product delivery to customer relationships. With Edge Commerce Stack ($197), creators can deploy a fully functional online store in 48 hours, complete with automatic payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This level of automation and control is unparalleled in the industry, making it the ideal choice for creators who value their independence.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice of commerce infrastructure ultimately depends on the creator's specific needs and goals. For those who prioritize speed and efficiency, a sovereign commerce infrastructure like NOWPayments is the way to go. For those who value automation and control, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is the perfect choice. By considering these options and choosing the right architecture, creators can build a sustainable and profitable online business, free from the limitations imposed by platform restrictions.
